name: io.github.pinguxx/elementum
title: Elementum Design System MCP
description: Component schemas, design tokens, snippet generation, and WCAG lint for @wcomp/elementum.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Lists all available Web Components in the Elementum Design System.

tools.name: get_component_doc
tools.description: Retrieves structured component API metadata (separated closed variants, boolean states, props, composition/JS constraints, events, slots, CSS parts, and standalone usage examples) for an Elementum component.

tag.description: The custom element tag name, e.g. "el-button" or "el-badge"

section.description: Optional filter: 'schema' returns variants, states, props, constraints, events, slots & parts without usage examples; 'examples' returns only usage examples; 'all' (default) returns both as separate sections.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Lists Figma design tokens (colors, spacing, radii) for the design system.

tools.name: generate_snippet
tools.description: Generates valid Elementum snippet in HTML, React TSX, Vue 3 SFC, or declarative A2UI JSON format.

label.description: Content text for the default slot

tools.name: scaffold_component
tools.description: Scaffolds standard boilerplate JavaScript code for a new Elementum Web Component adhering to design system standards.

formAssociated.description: Whether the component associates with forms

tools.name: lint_accessibility
tools.description: Static HTML accessibility linter for common WCAG 2.2 labeling and attribute issues (not a substitute for real-browser axe-core auditing).

tools.name: validate_accessibility
tools.description: Alias for lint_accessibility: static HTML accessibility linter for common WCAG 2.2 labeling issues.

tools.name: suggest_component
tools.description: Recommends Elementum Web Components that best match a UI requirement or natural-language query.

query.description: UI requirement, e.g. "date picker", "code diff", "command palette"

tools.name: validate_component_usage
tools.description: Validates <el-*> tags and attributes in an HTML snippet against the live Custom Elements Manifest to catch hallucinated tags or props.

tools.name: validate_a2ui_messages
tools.description: Validates A2UI JSON messages (createSurface, beginRendering, surfaceUpdate, dataModelUpdate, deleteSurface) against Elementum DEFAULT_A2UI_CATALOG and security rules.

messages.description: Array of A2UI JSON message objects to validate.

allowedTypes.description: Optional subset of allowed A2UI component types.

tools.name: get_component_maturity
tools.description: Returns machine-readable package version, component count, stability tier, and browser/testing verification metadata.
